data.name: Hotel Hideaway: Avatar & Chat
data.detailed_description:
TO PLAY HOTEL HIDEAWAY VIA STEAM WITH AN EXISTING ACCOUNT, YOU SHOULD CONNECT IT TO YOUR FACEBOOK ACCOUNT!

Step into Hotel Hideaway – a vibrant 3D social world where you can create, connect, and be whoever you want to be!

Express Your Style! Create and customize your 3D avatar with endless options. Choose from a huge variety of clothing, accessories, hairstyles, and tattoos – from casual streetwear to outrageous fantasy costumes. With new items released weekly, your look will always be fresh.

Design Your Space! Design your dream room with furniture and décor that matches your vibe. Host epic parties for your friends, create a private retreat, or show off your interior design skills to the world. The choice is yours.

Socialize & Explore! Meet new people from around the world, form tribes, and compete in groups for rewards. Explore the Hotel’s lively public spaces, uncover hidden secrets, and stand out in seasonal events and themed locations.

Always Something New! Party at the beach, relax at the spa, or attend live concerts by real-world artists. From fashion to friendship, adventure is always waiting.

So, what are you waiting for? Jump in and leave your mark on Hotel Hideaway today!

This game has an official IGRS rating of 18+.

content_descriptors.notes:
Although Hotel Hideaway: Avatar Chat contains no graphic violence, gore, or explicit sexual content, it is rated 18+ and designed for an adult audience. All “conflict” is playful—think pillow fights or harmless pranks—with no combat system, blood, or injury depicted. Avatars may wear swimwear or lounge attire, but there is no nudity or sexual acts shown.

Because it’s a live-service social MMO, user chat can sometimes feature strong language, suggestive banter, or mature role-play. Virtual venues often include decorative bar counters and pixel “drinks,” but there is no real substance-use mechanics or intoxication effects. We do not depict sexual assault, non-consensual acts, self-harm, or drug abuse in any storyline or event.

To maintain a safe environment for our adult community, we employ AI-driven moderation alongside block/ignore/report tools—so you remain in control of your social space. 

Only for players aged 17 and up who are comfortable with open chat and user-generated content.
